description.en: Turns every file artifact the agent names in chat into a clickable entry — and refuses to paint one that does not resolve. Hover resolves asynchronously, and only a file that really exists becomes a hand pointer with a dashed blue outline (30 s TTL cache, so repeated hovers cost nothing); confirmed non-artifacts stay plain text and the right-click falls through to the host menu untouched. Left click reveals the file in Explorer already selected (Shell.Application Explore plus SelectItem with SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE, so the pane scrolls to it; explorer.exe /select is deliberately not used because it silently drops the selection when an instance is already running). Right click offers seven actions: preview in DSH's built-in sidebar, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save as, copy the file itself to the clipboard, copy the absolute path, or insert the path into the composer. Ctrl or Shift with left click opens with the default app, Alt with left click copies the path. Names resolve through the absolute path, the session workspace and every profile workspace, then a cached basename index built with a depth budget, shrinking from the left when a mention swallows leading words. The host half also keeps six system-prompt rules resident, so absolute paths stay in tool arguments while the body shows only file names, and every route is loopback-only.
description.zh: 把对话里出现的每个文件产物变成可点入口，并且拒绝给解析不到的文件画芯片。悬停时先异步解析，只有文件真的存在才变手型并画蓝色虚线框（结果进 30 秒 TTL 缓存，反复悬停不重复请求）；确认不是产物的片段保持普通文字，右键直接放行宿主原生菜单。左键在资源管理器里定位并选中该文件（Shell.Application 的 Explore + SelectItem，带 SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE 所以会自动滚到可见处；刻意不用 explorer.exe /select，因为已有窗口时它会静默丢掉选中）。右键七项：在侧边栏预览、用默认程序打开、在文件夹中显示、另存为、复制文件、复制文件路径、添加到对话框。Ctrl/Shift+左键用默认程序打开，Alt+左键复制路径。路径按绝对路径、会话工作区、各 profile 工作区、以及带深度预算的同名文件索引逐级解析，遇到「提及吞掉了前面几个词」时从左收缩重试。宿主侧还常驻六条系统提示词铁律，让绝对路径留在工具参数里、正文只写文件名；所有路由仅回环可用。

description.en: Estimated carbon footprint of your DeepSeek Harness sessions: sourced factors, confidence bands, durable local history, and a GUI
description.zh: 估算你每次 DeepSeek Harness 会话的碳排放，给出可信区间并留存本地历史，还能用图形界面查看。

description.en: Chrome extension and DeepSeek Harness plugin for browser control and debugging. Initial version under development.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接读取、操作和调试本机 Chrome 标签页，能点击、填表、截图、看控制台和网络。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that makes your cursor more fluid, leaving a glowing trail as you move.
description.zh: 把系统指针换成 DeepSeek 蓝色圆点，带呼吸光晕和拖尾，让鼠标移动更有质感。

description.en: 住在自己手机上的角色，DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：自带 Android 手机、她自己的 QQ、来自真实事件的记忆与日记、两次对话之间的生活（幕间）、可选 VM 电脑。A character who lives on her own phone, for DSH.
description.zh: 把 dsh 变成常驻在线的个人 AI 助手，自带电脑，能通过微信等 IM 找到它，还能定时干活、限制预算。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入「破甲模式」的 Agent 预设方案

DeepSeek Harness plugin: connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway as one LLM provider with models grouped by upstream provider, read-only usage cards, model visibility, default effort and per-session fast mode
description.zh: 把自建 Magpie 网关接成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型供应商，按上游分组选模型，还能看用量卡片。

description.en: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件：给 AI 角色一份会淡、会不确定、只知道它该知道的事的记忆。本地优先，可选 MemU 引擎。
description.zh: 给 AI 角色一份会淡忘、会不确定、只知道该知道的事的本地记忆，适合长篇 RP 和陪伴聊天。

description.en: Tailor a repository to fit: 8-dimension maturity audit, 7 README styles, bilingual drafts, deterministic brand assets, pre-release verification. DSH plugin.
description.zh: 给仓库做一次全面体检，从 README 风格到品牌素材和发布前检查，帮你把项目打磨到敢发出去。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement beside the DeepSeek Harness composer: rewrites a draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在输入框旁一键润色提示词，原地改写草稿，不发送也能让表达更清晰。

description.en: Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.
Live DeepSeek balance, per-turn charge and today's spend in a draggable DSH panel — measured from the billing counter to 1e-8 CNY.
description.zh: 在可拖拽面板里实时查看 DeepSeek 余额、每轮扣费和今日花费，精确到 1e-8 元。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that drives chat.deepseek.com in a real browser - a free DeepSeek API alternative. Chat, DeepThink and web search on your own account: no API key, no cost per token.
description.zh: 用真实浏览器代跑 chat.deepseek.com，不花 API 钱，订阅内随便用。

description.en: Visual memory and active inspection for DeepSeek Harness: revisit any image, inspect any region, read exact pixels.
description.zh: 让 AI 记住看过的图片，随时回看任意图片、放大检查局部区域、读取精确像素。

description.en: A local task board with secretary, CEO, and historian roles, plus a desktop whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地工作任务看板，带秘书、CEO、史官三个角色和鲸鱼娘浮窗，数据保存在本机。

description.en: Use QuickTUI with DeepSeek Harness (dsh): install QuickTUI server, pair the phone app, and follow dsh sessions from your phone.
description.zh: 在电脑上装好 QuickTUI 服务并配对手机 App，就能随时用手机查看 dsh 会话进度。

description.en: DSH ComfyUI workbench: asset library + arbitrary workflow runner

CRT terminal skin with a phosphor-green palette, scanlines and monospace type for DeepSeek Harness. Also adds a sidebar dashboard with output speed, CPU/memory and DeepSeek balance; the key stays in the host process.
description.zh: 深色磷光绿 CRT 终端皮肤，带扫描线和等宽字体，用于 DeepSeek Harness。另在侧栏加仪表盘：输出速度、CPU/内存与 DeepSeek 余额；密钥只留在宿主进程。

description.en: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。

description.en: Hot reload and one-click restart for DSH plugin development. Reload uses DSH's built-in reload instead of a private reimplementation, so it behaves the way the host expects: only changed plugins refresh, the rest keep running. Restart is the safe one - it runs outside the client, so it still brings the client back when the client is what changed; it refuses while a session or job runs; it confirms the client reopened. Lightweight: one tool, no arguments, nothing added to the model's context, buttons off by default.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的热重载与一键重启。重载用 DSH 自带的重载，而不是另造一套，所以行为和宿主一致：只刷新有改动的插件，其余继续运行。重启是安全的那个：跑在客户端之外，所以即使要换掉的正是客户端本身也能重新拉起；有会话或后台任务在跑时直接拒绝；并确认客户端真的重新打开了。轻量：只多一个工具、不带参数、不向模型上下文注入内容，按钮默认不出现。

description.en: Step-by-step workflow map for DeepSeek Harness: folds session events into a step list with per-step status, a percentage whose source (todo table, self-report, time baseline or plan ordinal) is labelled, tool and file-type interfaces either side of each unit, a detail page, and hot injection that queues a prompt for the next step with revoke before it is claimed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分步工作流地图：将会话事件折叠为分步列表，标注每步状态与百分比来源（待办表/自报/时间基线/计划步序），每步两侧挂工具与文件类型接口并可打开详情页；热注入把提示词排入下一步执行队列，被取用前可撤回。

description.en: Native Deepwork roles, routing, profiles, and permission controls for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让多个 Agent 分工干活，各角色可配不同模型和备用模型，还能保存常用方案、防护 Git 写操作。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — zero-config, out-of-the-box
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 AnySearch 网页搜索能力，开箱即用，让智能体轻松获取实时信息。

description.en: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.
description.zh: 为本地 tempguard 温度守护提供两个 DSH 工具：读取温度与 alertd 健康状态，以及通过 alertd 发送告警。需另行在本机运行 tempguard Python 看门狗及其 alertd 服务，并在 profile patch 里配置 projectDir 与 alertdToken；暂无 npm 包，需克隆仓库后从子目录本地安装。

description.en: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
description.zh: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness permission guard: work inside the workspace is never interrupted; only the extra permission a call asks for is judged — machine-safe actions pass, system changes ask with a consequence analysis, destructive ones are refused.
description.zh: 只审查调用额外申请的权限，工作区内的操作不打断，安全动作直接放行，系统改动才弹窗确认。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话「看清再动手」外挂：归档/彻底删除（系统回收站）+ 会话内容只读预览（Markdown），零依赖、不 patch 官方。
description.zh: 删会话前先预览内容，归档或彻底删除都心里有数，零依赖不折腾官方。

description.en: Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness. A banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails; the badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that session. Follows the DSH interface language, subagent sessions stay quiet by default, titles and body length are configurable, and a loopback HTTP interface lets scripts and other tools post notifications.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加桌面通知与应用图标未读角标：一轮结束、等待审批／回答／计划确认、以及这一轮出错时各弹一条横幅；角标显示有几个会话需要你，看过之后清零，点横幅切到对应会话。文案跟随 DSH 界面语言，子智能体会话默认不提醒，标题与正文长度可配置；宿主还在回环地址上开了一个 HTTP 接口，供脚本和其它工具发通知。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international builds appear as two separate provider groups. Continuation of the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect; it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Project-level MCP servers loaded automatically: a project declares them in `.agents/mcp.json` (path and root markers configurable), and every session working inside that project mounts them in its own scope — stdio and Streamable HTTP, tools named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` — with the connections closed when the session ends. A Web UI panel lists the session's servers and their tools, and can enable or disable a project entry after confirmation, backing up and atomically rewriting the manifest.
description.zh: 自动加载项目级 MCP 服务器：项目在 `.agents/mcp.json` 中声明服务器（路径与根目录标记可配置），在项目内工作的每个会话各自的作用域里挂载——支持 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP，工具名为 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`——会话结束时断开连接。Web UI 面板列出本会话的服务器及其工具，并可在确认后启用或禁用项目条目，写入前备份并原子替换清单文件。

description.en: Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose. On a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only the packages you check, and skips local link or file installs, pinned versions and packages with errors; upgrades stay inside the major version and skip prereleases by default. Updates go through the profile's own plugin manager, so the profile write lock, pnpm step, bundle-patch validation and hot reload are the host's, and a failed install puts the previous version back. Each cycle is appended to a JSON log.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做按包白名单的自动更新：按计划去 npm 查已装插件的最新版本，只更新你勾选的包，本地 link／file 安装、锁定版本和出错的包一律跳过；默认不跨大版本、不装预发布。更新走 profile 里运行中的官方插件管理器，profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle 补丁校验与热重载都由宿主负责，安装失败会把旧版本装回去。每轮结果追加到一份 JSON 日志。

description.en: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.
description.zh: 在官方「工作区」标题行上，为每个已接入账号的 dsh-im 通道添加一个 28x28 图标按钮。点击后侧栏切到该通道视图，只显示它的会话、隐藏其余所有行；再次点击回到官方列表。只有已接入账号的通道才会出现按钮。

description.en: Host-side Feishu board for DeepSeek Harness: pushes a session's ask_user_question to Feishu DM as plain text and sends a quoted reply back to the exact session that asked, archiving unmatched replies instead of guessing. Its lark-cli wrapper also suppresses an identical notification resent within three minutes.
description.zh: 宿主侧飞书公告板：把会话的 ask_user_question 以纯文本推到飞书私聊，引用回复只投回提问的那个会话，匹配不上的回复存档不猜；lark-cli 发送包装会拦下三分钟内重复的同一通知。

description.en: AI persona, emotion and fading memory for DeepSeek Harness: layered compression keeps personality, emotion and turning-point nodes, painful feelings fade while the facts stay. One memory document is auto-delivered after three months and then monthly; long absences freeze the forgetting clock instead of mass-forgetting on return.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会淡忘的性格、情感与记忆：分层压缩后只保留性格、情感与转折节点，痛苦感受强制淡忘而事实保留；一份记忆文档在满 3 个月后自动交付、之后每月一份；长时间不在会冻结遗忘计时，不会一回来就批量淡忘。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only (WPF via PowerShell). Independent fork of zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta (MIT); do not run alongside the upstream.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

description.en: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种界面语言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français），语料随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.
description.zh: 会话列旁的可折叠栏：把对话按工作区与主题组织成树，就地打开真实会话，并通过 9 个模型工具让助手读写这棵树。

description.en: Visibility layer for the built-in Cua Driver computer-control channel: a top banner names the controlling session and its goal, and Esc truly stops the agent.
description.zh: 给官方内置 Cua Driver 电脑控制通道加一层可见提示：顶部横幅显示是哪个会话、基于什么目标在控制电脑，按 Esc 真正停止。

description.en: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH Coding Agent extension and the plugin discovers and connects automatically on the same Windows machine, or connect manually elsewhere by pasting the copied connection address.
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 VS Code 连接起来，提供类似 Claude Code for VS Code 的使用体验，直接在 VS Code 中接续同一工作区与同一会话：下载 VS Code 扩展 DSH Coding Agent，插件在 Windows 同机会自动发现并连接，其他平台可复制连接地址后手动连接。

description.en: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

description.en: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookkeeping - no ghost rows on any connected desktop web UI. Workspace files the session created are kept; conversation logs are permanently deleted. Third-party cloud mirrors (e.g. phone apps via Agents Anywhere) hold their own copies. Bilingual zh/en UI, trust-fenced local route. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: 给侧边栏每个会话的"…"菜单加上"删除会话"（官方只有归档/置顶/重命名/分叉，无持久 删除）。一键「强制删除」：逐出宿主内存态会话、停止后台工作后，彻底清除会话日志、 投影缓存与注册表记账，已连接的桌面 Web 端即时清行、不留幽灵。会话生成的工作区文件 保留，对话记录永久删除；第三方云端镜像（如经 Agents Anywhere 同步的手机 App）持有 各自副本、需在其 App 内管理。中英双语界面，本地回环路由带信任栅栏。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·整皮版，仅适用于 dsh Web 界面：把 Web 前端整体换成自包含的像素农场界面——祝尼魔对话、农场选预设、任务日志 HUD、会话即游戏日的山谷日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠。不支持桌面原生窗口，请勿与其他会改变 UI 的插件同时启用。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server version, and reports capability gaps in a settings card.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.
description.zh: 通过重绘左侧工作区侧栏，为工作区侧栏添加颜色高亮、排序、收藏、状态指示以及系统通知等功能。同时可切换回原版侧栏，也具有部分功能实现。

description.en: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.
description.zh: macOS 菜单栏伴侣的宿主插件：实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态，可直接批准/拒绝工具审批、停止当前回合、打开对应会话。原生应用以通用二进制免费发布于 GitHub Releases。

description.en: Shows per-turn, per-session and per-workspace conversation costs in CNY, priced by DeepSeek's official tiers with peak/off-peak hours and per-request Search/Fetch billing.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方价目显示每轮、每会话与每工作区的对话费用人民币金额，支持峰谷分时与 Search/Fetch 按次计费。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native model selector.
description.zh: 在输入框中提供 Plan/Build 模式切换：按 Tab 键或点击工具栏按钮即可切换，并按模式分别记住右侧原生模型选择器中所选的模型。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强：统一各处 Markdown 排版、划词批注（带编号的段落标记）、可拖到 214px 并记住宽度的侧栏、首次启动铺满屏幕、侧栏面板与插件图标合并为顶部一行（每行 5 个），以及运行中会话的彩色状态环。

description.en: Sends QQ mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Registers the send_qq_email tool with a user-approval step and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 用已授权的 agently-cli 账号发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具（发送前需用户确认），并对外提供 ctx.qqEmail 服务供其他 DSH 插件调用。

description.en: Dual-host coordination for DeepSeek Harness: hand a task off in local chat, run bounded jobs in a cloud worker, then review results and approve follow-up steps in one workbench. Includes protected six-page onboarding, per-task model selection, a task approval ledger and stepwise controlled delivery.
description.zh: DSH 双端协作：在本地对话中自然语言交办，云端独立 worker 执行有界任务，在工作台查看成果并逐步审批后续动作。含六页保护性配置导览、按任务选模型、审批账本与受控交付。

description.en: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other tools from one DSH sidebar page: CRUD, cross-tool sharing, import/export, backups and MCP health checks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏统一管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的 skill 与 MCP 服务器：增删改查、跨工具共享、导入导出、备份恢复与 MCP 连接体检。

description.en: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).
description.zh: 会话标题栏的三点菜单：可下载会话日志，把每个会话的转录在普通与详细视图间切换，并自定义详细视图展开哪些内容（思考块、工具调用、终端输出）。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter 换行、Shift+Enter 发送，模式按设备记忆。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.
description.zh: 把当前 Chrome 标签页附到 DSH 草稿：一次点击截图（失败时降级为 macOS 窗口截图），同时把页面标题与地址写成一行放进输入框。

description.en: Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read, doc_meta and doc_ocr.
description.zh: 把 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和文本文件读取为智能体工具，并用 tesseract.js 在本地对扫描版 PDF 或图片做 OCR。提供 doc_read、pdf_read、xlsx_read、doc_meta、doc_ocr 五个工具。

description.en: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
description.zh: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

description.en: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.
description.zh: 将会话视图移入 Windows 标题栏、其余顶栏工具压缩进紧凑右轨，在 DSH Desktop 与 Codex UI 中保留会话标题、全屏、动态状态计数与菜单功能，同时省下一整行垂直空间。

description.en: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.
description.zh: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 2-2-1 征召助手，支持分段与职业数据口径、灵活分路成员池、参战勾选和 BP 后预测胜率。

description.en: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
description.zh: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed for 180 days by default, so a plugin is still findable for months after a hot streak.
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: OpenSpec spec-driven workflows for DeepSeek Harness, generated from OpenSpec 1.14.3: twelve /opsx-* slash commands that carry the workflow prompt plus the arguments you type, and twelve openspec-* skills the model loads on its own.
description.zh: 把 OpenSpec 的规格驱动工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，内容由 OpenSpec 1.14.3 生成：12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令会把工作流提示词与你输入的参数一起注入会话，另有 12 个由模型自行加载的 openspec-* 技能。

description.en: Non-commercial DeepSeek Harness port of Academic Research Skills: 5 skills, 16 /ars-* commands, 4 agent roles, write-scope guard, deterministic Python gates (CC BY-NC 4.0).
description.zh: 把学术研究技能包搬进 DeepSeek Harness，帮你做文献综述、同行评审和系统性研究。

description.en: 信息源聚合 DSH 插件：定时摄取 RSS / B 站 / YouTube，读正文与字幕做本地预筛和三档判断，每轮出一份增量汇报。彻底不做平台互动。
description.zh: 定时抓取 RSS、B 站和 YouTube，读正文和字幕帮你筛掉水文和标题党，每轮出一份增量汇报。

description.en: Connects Harness to the published BeatBrowser runtime with namespaced MCP tools and a TaskSpace Skill; requires the Chrome extension and preserves manual takeover.
description.zh: 通过带命名空间的 MCP 工具和任务空间 Skill 接入已发布的 BeatBrowser；需要 Chrome 扩展，保留人工接管规则。

description.en: Four native tools for image/video model discovery, contract inspection, pricing previews, approved generation and resumable task status through BeatAPI.
description.zh: 提供图片视频模型发现、接口检查、价格预览、确认后生成及原任务续查，通过 BeatAPI 执行。

description.en: Five native tools for Social Data discovery, pricing previews, approved reads, stored-result retrieval and source tables; requires a BeatAPI key for paid reads.
description.zh: 提供社媒能力发现、价格预览、确认后读取、历史结果取回及来源表格；付费读取需要 BeatAPI key。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件，把 Codex-Skins 那套"壁纸 + 半透明面板"的主题系统搬到 Harness 上，并提供三件事： 主题管理界面：设置 →「主题皮肤」里的主题库、当前主题、壁纸可见度、删除、导出。 导入 Codex 主题：扫描本机 `CodexDreamSkin\themes`，或导入任意主题文件夹 / 分发 ZIP。 AI 主题设计：用一句话（可配一张图）生成或改造一套主题，直接入库。 同时把能力暴露成 `skin_theme` 工具，智能体在对话里也能列出、导入、应用、生成皮肤。
已归档DSH（DeepSeek Harness）会话的只读查看器：不取消归档，就能浏览归档列表、阅读完整对话与工具调用。
description.zh: 不用取消归档，就能翻看已归档的 DSH 会话列表和完整对话、工具调用记录。

description.en: Persistent project memory and Claude Code-compatible rules for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 给 DSH 项目加上持久记忆，还能兼容 Claude Code 规则，让 AI 记住项目上下文。

description.en: Native macOS notifications for DeepSeek Harness — turn finished, approval waiting, questions, background jobs, subagents and workflows; click a banner to open the Session.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上原生 macOS 通知，任务完成、待审批、提问或后台任务结束都会弹窗提醒，点一下直接回到会话。

description.en: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps after a minute of inactivity, and offers an enable switch, four sizes and a status-reaction toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 一只住在 DSH 网页界面上的动画像素猫，会跟随 agent 的状态变化——会话平静时坐着，运行中躺下并入睡，回合结束或开始打字时醒来。可以拖到任意位置并记住坐标，闲置一分钟后入睡，设置里有开关、四档尺寸和状态联动选项。

description.en: Single-choice board in the DeepSeek Harness chat: pick one of several answers, images or sounds

Merges AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper and zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix — two composer model-seat plugins that cannot be installed together — into one control: a Provider / Model trigger opening a two-column card where hovering the provider column swaps the models without moving the card, a separate reasoning-effort trigger with a particle slider, and a search that spans every provider while the card keeps its size.
description.zh: 把 AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper 与 zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix 这两个无法同时安装的输入框模型控件合并成一个控件：「供应商/模型」钮点开是两栏卡片，鼠标所指供应商的模型就地切换、卡片不移动；推理强度是旁边的独立钮，带粒子滑杆；搜索跨全部供应商，且卡片尺寸保持不变。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示 Codex 的 5 小时与每周剩余额度
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏和底栏随时查看 Codex 的 5 小时与每周剩余额度，心里有数不超支。

description.en: Minimal composer balance chip for DeepSeek Harness: account balance + current-session spend, in the host's own visual language.
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和本次会话花费，一眼看清用量和开销。

description.en: Writes the session's estimated cost into the composer token-usage pill, and adds a per-bucket amount plus an estimated total to the usage dialogs, using DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates in yuan.
description.zh: 把本次会话的估算费用直接写进输入框上方的 Token 用量胶囊，并在用量弹窗里为每个分项补上金额与预估合计，按 DeepSeek 官方高峰与空闲时段价（人民币）计算。

description.en: CursorLike — Cursor-style coding surface for DeepSeek Harness (DSH plugin: pending-files card, side Monaco editor, diff review, AI edit)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Cursor 风格的编码界面，边聊边改代码，还能看 diff 审阅 AI 的改动。

description.en: Infron.ai model provider for DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible streaming, an auto-refreshed 300+ model catalog, and Models-page settings for the API key and model selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里接入 Infron.ai 模型，支持流式对话和 300+ 模型自动更新，填个 API Key 就能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 多把 API Key 池 + 一键切换 + 每把 key 的实时余额
description.zh: 把多把 DeepSeek API Key 放进一个池子，一键切换当前用的那把，还能随时看到每把 key 还剩多少钱。

description.en: Russian language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上俄语，界面菜单和提示都能显示俄文。

description.en: DSH plugin — workspace-scoped MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness: each project directory gets its own MCP tools.
description.zh: 给每个项目目录配上独立的 MCP 服务器，只把当前工作区的工具暴露给会话，互不干扰。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：在设置 → MCP 管理页面里用一段 JSON 添加 MCP，校验后写入 DSH 官方 MCP 维护配置文件 cordis.patch.yml 并回显列表
Deepseek Harness memory plugin
description.zh: 给编程 Agent 加分层长期记忆，能记住经验、技能和知识图谱，越用越懂你。

description.en: DSH 宿主长期记忆插件：markdown + git + 分层索引
OpenCode as a DSH subagent, with a live ACP trace panel for its agents and self-spawned subagents
A draggable pet in a blue-whale onesie for DeepSeek Harness: sticks to the window edges, squashes flat, blinks, sleeps, and reports agent status in a thought cloud.
description.zh: 一只穿蓝鲸连体衣的桌面宠物，趴在窗口边卖萌打滚，顺便用气泡告诉你 agent 在忙什么。

description.en: Client-side rendering optimizations for DSH Desktop: skips offscreen message rendering, pauses frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads media, coalesces session-list repaints, pre-warms large session files, and shows the measured main-thread saving in settings.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端纯客户端渲染优化：长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏不排帧、后台暂停定时器、媒体懒加载、会话列表节流、大会话文件预热，设置页显示实测省下的主线程时间。

description.en: Local knowledge base and document search for DeepSeek Harness with full-text search, PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/Markdown import, OCR, ACL, and a Web panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库与文档检索插件：全文搜索、PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/Markdown 导入与按行读取、扫描件 OCR、ACL 和 Web 面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：零配置复用千问办公（QwenWorkCN）桌面 App 的登录态，把它注册为 DSH 模型 Provider，支持流式对话、工具调用、图片输入与实时积分读数，无需 API Key。A DSH plugin that reuses your QwenWorkCN desktop login as a model provider — streaming, tool calls, image input and live credits, no API key.
description.zh: 不用 API Key，直接复用千问办公桌面 App 的登录态，把它变成 DSH 里能流式对话、调工具、看图、看积分的模型。

description.en: Restart DeepSeek Harness from the sidebar or from an agent tool, with a watchdog, profile rollback and auto-continue
DSH 客户端插件 dsh-runner：输入框下方运行命令，设置页与 AI 工具管理启动命令，支持 GitHub 更新提示。
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方加个「▶ 运行」按钮，随手选命令执行，还能在设置页管理启动命令并接收 GitHub 更新提示。

description.en: 代码安全防御规则评审判官：自动识别做代码的会话，按《代码安全防御架构规则》强制评审并门禁，需要 1/2/多种架构推荐与冲突检查，发布含 SBOM 与签名。
description.zh: 自动识别写代码的会话，按安全防御架构规则强制评审并门禁，未通过不能算完成。

description.en: Threadloom — session management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: browse, filter, inspect, batch-manage and trash/restore sessions across workspaces, with read-only agent tools.
Group DSH sidebar sessions by date inside every workspace / 按日期分组显示 DSH 侧边栏会话
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏每个工作区的会话按日期分组，每天标出具体日期，找会话更直观。

description.en: Shared scrolling for DeepSeek Harness sidebar navigation, projects, and conversations.
description.zh: 让侧边栏的导航、项目和对话一起滚动，下滑时导航自动让位，给内容腾出更多空间。

description.en: A DSH skill that reviews third-party plugin bundles before install: npm metadata, unpacked static audit with file:line evidence, A/B/C verdict, and quarantine dry-run.
description.zh: 装第三方插件前先帮你查一遍安全，带文件行号证据，给出 A/B/C 评级和隔离试运行。

description.en: Local TTS + emotion simulation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (IndexTTS2, 8-dim emotion vector, emotion dynamics; optional QQ voice delivery)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上完全本地的中文语音，还能带着连续变化的情绪说话。

description.en: 贾维斯式语音助手 for DSH：本地唤醒词「贾维斯」+ 中文识别 + 语音朗读回答
description.zh: 喊一声「贾维斯」就能用语音跟 DSH 对话，本地识别中文、自动发送，还能把回答读出来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的免费优先搜索 provider：Exa/Bing/DuckDuckGo/SerpAPI 自动降级
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个免费优先的搜索源，Exa、Bing、DuckDuckGo、SerpAPI 自动降级，省钱又省心。

description.en: Web search insights for the agent: it keeps a local log of what was looked up and which pages came back, and counts searches, returned pages, citations and pages opened per turn and across the session, with the numbers shown in a small entry under the answer and a right-sidebar panel.
description.zh: 联网搜索的「搜索洞察」：记下 Agent 查了什么、搜回哪些网页，并统计每轮与整个会话的搜索次数、返回网页数、被引用数与被打开读过的页数；这些数字在回答下方的引用入口和右侧栏面板里随时能回看。

description.en: Annotate web pages inside DeepSeek Harness's built-in browser: click an element, leave a comment, send the batch (with screenshots) to the conversation.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里点网页元素写批注，一键把带截图的修改意见发进对话，指哪改哪。

description.en: A headless bridge for an agent to use Linux WeChat.
description.zh: 让智能体在 Linux 上直接操作微信，无需登录协议、不改进程、不碰凭证，自动化收发消息。

description.en: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

description.en: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.
description.zh: 带 macOS 原生桌宠与 Windows/Linux Electron 桌宠的 DSH 伴侣。桌宠肚子上始终显示 DSH 账户余额，并支持任务配色、进度与通知。

description.en: Ocean, dual-view cosmos and local video backgrounds with per-skin settings for DeepSeek Harness. Built on Open Sea Skin (d-dev0101/open-sea-skin) — do not install both.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供海洋、宇宙双视角与本地视频背景，支持各皮肤独立设置。沿用 Open Sea Skin（d-dev0101）的上游实现，请勿与上游同时安装。

description.en: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.
description.zh: 简化RooCode和Cline在VSCode插件上的功能，为 Plan 与 Act 两种模式各绑定一套 provider、模型与思考复杂度，支持按工作区覆盖。

description.en: Adds a scissors button to the DSH composer: freeze the desktop, drag a region, and insert the crop as an image attachment. Ctrl+Alt+1 captures with DSH hidden, Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1 keeps DSH visible. Windows only.
description.zh: 最有效率的 DSH 提示词框截图快捷按钮，不必再粘贴图片：Ctrl+Alt+1 自动隐藏 DSH 窗口截屏；Shift+Ctrl+Alt+1 不隐藏截屏；点按钮自动隐藏窗口截屏，Shift+点击不隐藏。反复截屏时按住 Ctrl+Alt 连续点按钮。按钮放在提示框第三位防误触，截图后可直接改提示词。截图默认存到当前会话文件夹，文件名为秒级时间戳，并默认保存两份（会话文件夹 + DSH 附件库）；删除对话不会连带删图，需要自行在「删除对话」插件里处理。

description.en: Independent extension pack and patch set for @zaofan/dsh-qqbot — install that plugin first (pinned to 1.10.39). Adds two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal recall/consolidation, a persona that keeps learning (influence from close people plus Bilibili/Douyin activity distilled into a daily self-reflection), persona drift guard, group tiers, local-model quick replies with a single-brain arbiter, TTS outbox, sticker library, and an approval-gated video studio that plans storyboards, quality-gates frames and drafts Bilibili posts for review.
description.zh: 独立扩展包与补丁集，依赖并锁定 @zaofan/dsh-qqbot 1.10.39（请先装本体）。提供两层 SQLite 记忆（类海马体召回/巩固）、会自己长的人格（特别关心的人影响性格，B站/抖音的运营事件被收成摘要参与每天一次的自我反思）、人格漂移护栏、群分级、本地小模型代答与单脑仲裁、TTS 发件箱、表情包库，以及一条“主人审核”的视频流水线（分镜编排、出图质检、程序化 2D 角色动效、B 站草稿待审）。

description.en: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions and per-chapter distillation. PDF support is text-based only; scanned or encrypted PDFs are rejected.
description.zh: 在侧边面板里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转、划线笔记与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答，以及按章蒸馏。PDF 仅支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。

description.en: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

description.en: 这是一个DeepseekHarness的情感人格插件

Bounded cron & interval scheduling for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — every task bound to exactly one session (creator or a dedicated new one), never global. Complements dsh-schedule with real cron expressions.
description.zh: 用 cron 表达式或固定间隔定时给 AI 智能体派活，让任务按计划自动执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：AI 聚合网关可视化控制台——集成 Google Antigravity 与 OpenAI Codex 反代、多账号轮换池、5h/周额度看板与故障转移。
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity 和 OpenAI Codex 聚合成一个本地网关，多账号自动轮换、看额度、故障自动切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 投标人资格条件核对表：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 逐条核对投标人资格条件与证明材料，只标出对不上的地方，帮你快速查漏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 应急演练脚本核对：依据《生产安全事故应急演练基本规范》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查应急演练脚本是否完整、步骤和响应级别算得对不对，帮你提前发现漏洞。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 起诉状核对：依据《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 帮你逐项核对起诉状或申请书要素是否齐全，事实、证据、法律依据、金额一个都不漏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 机动车维修工单核对：依据《机动车维修管理规定》（交通运输部令2021年第18号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 自动核对机动车维修工单的金额和填写完整性，算错、漏填一眼就能发现。

description.en: Persistent GitHub-style review threads for DeepSeek Harness diffs
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的代码 diff 加上像 GitHub 那样能长期保留的审查讨论串，方便逐行评审和跟进。

description.en: Full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness (fork of haoku123/dsh-voice): streamed ASR, TTS with first-sentence/first-paragraph modes, barge-in, message replay, live settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上全双工语音对话，说话即问、边听边答，还能随时插话打断。

description.en: An animated companion that shows live DSH agent progress in the macOS notch.
description.zh: 在 Mac 刘海屏上养一只会动的桌面小伙伴，实时显示 DSH 任务进度，悬停还能展开看详情。

description.en: DSH plugin: daily YouTube scroll — channel RSS + keyword search → transcript-first selection (local Whisper fallback, thumbnail vision) → Traditional Chinese daily report on an off-peak schedule.
description.zh: 每天自动刷 YouTube 频道和关键词视频，挑出有内容的生成繁中日报，省时省力。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and explicit human acceptance. Requires Node.js 24+ and Git.
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Sensitive-data guard for DeepSeek Harness: blocks credential reads/outbound secrets and redacts secrets, tokens, and PII before they reach the model, logs, or spill files.
description.zh: 在敏感信息进入模型、日志或落盘前自动拦截凭据读取、阻断密钥外发，并脱敏密钥、令牌和个人信息。

description.en: Universal notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: in-app toasts, native Windows toasts, one-click approval from the action center
description.zh: 新会话、待审批、任务完成或中断都会及时提醒，还能在通知中心一键批准，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for team member management: two-level group→member org structure, Chinese display names & aliases, job titles & duties, skill tagging, retire/restore, and per-member model overrides. Ships as host tools + a Web management panel; keeps its own overlay registry so the immutable DSH core is never touched. MIT licensed.
description.zh: 管理团队分组和成员信息，支持中文名、岗位、技能标签，还能给每个成员单独配置模型。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端里选中文字，选区末尾会出现一个翻译按钮，点击即就地翻译这段文字。翻译走宿主 llm 服务，直接复用当前会话已选的模型，无需另外配置 API Key；也可改用任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。结果在保持于视口内的浮层中展示，支持一键复制、一排语言按钮即时重译，默认智能中英互译（中文译英、其他语言译中）。配置保存在宿主端，其中的 API Key 永不下发到浏览器。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin bridging Tencent Docs official MCP endpoint (docs.qq.com) · 腾讯文档官方 MCP 桥（社区非官方）
description.zh: 把腾讯文档官方 MCP 端点接进 DSH，扫码取票即可用，无需手动配置凭据。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
description.zh: 基于 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 的通用联网搜索插件：配置 baseURL / API Key / 模型即可让内置 web_search 工具对接 Qwen Token Plan、OpenAI 等任意网关。

description.en: One-shot entrance animation when the workspace opens: the logo is written onto the canvas, then an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.
description.zh: 打开工作台时的一次性入场动画：标识逐字擦出，退场时反色色块扫过全屏，深浅主题自动镜像。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: 已迁移到 monorepo：https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-plugins（packages/dsh-theme-studio，后续版本从那里发布）
description.zh: 一键换装你的 DSH 界面：预设主题、强调色、间距、圆角、字体随便调，还能加自定义 CSS。

description.en: 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，并加进 DSH 的模型选择器。
description.zh: 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，直接加进 DSH 模型选择器，省去手动配置。

description.en: DSH 已归档会话管理器：插件 + RPC/端到端工具
description.zh: 给 DSH 已归档会话补上删除功能，支持单条、批量、清空，默认进回收站 30 天内可恢复。

description.en: deepseek-harness 参考库插件
description.zh: 给每个会话挂个只读参考库，agent 回答前先去你指定的本地目录查证，查不到才允许外部搜索。

description.en: Клиент для сайта https://hireseeker.ru позволяет искать вакансии на платформе с помощью собственной среды разработки, без необходимости открывать сайт и браузер
description.zh: 在终端里直接搜 HireSeeker 上的招聘信息，不用开浏览器就能找工作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：文生图 / 图片生成 / AI 绘画，基于火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）。零依赖、纯 JavaScript、无需构建。 | DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, plain JavaScript, no build step.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用火山方舟 Seedream 模型，输入文字就能生成图片，零依赖开箱即用。

description.en: Backup & restore plugin for DeepSeek Harness: workspace, full conversations (byte-exact), attachments, settings and dsh-mnemon memory data in one zip
description.zh: 把工作区、对话、附件、设置和记忆打包成一个 ZIP，换机重装后一键还原。
